title: Rotgut's Gotta Have WMDs
description: Rotgut's Gotta Have WMDs — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Gee Dubya Shrub //TEMP

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Collect evidence of Rotgut's WMDs in the Mutanous Malaise, then return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Gee Dubya Shrub //TEMP

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect evidence of Rotgut's WMDs in the Mutanous Malaise, then return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

I refuse to believe that Rotgut doesn't have Weapons of Mass Destruction. It's just impossidiculous! Rotgut has been known to sell arms so it is just a natural step in logitude that he'd be storing WMDs.

Do me a favor, Dungeon Runner. Keep searching Mutanous Malaise for WMDs because I have a gut feeling that they are there somewhere.

Once you have checked all the reported locations for WMDs return to me, Gee Dubya Shrub, here in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Turn-in:

Nothing, eh? Well, that just tells me that something has to be there.

Objectives:

  • Find Rotgut's WMD on Level 2
  • Find Rotgut's WMD on Level 4
  • Find Rotgut's WMD on Level 6
  • Find Rotgut's WMD on Level 7

Level range: 30–50
